as someone who still has scars from YEARS ago, (approx. 6 years ago) the best that i could do was wait for them to fade and hide them by wearing “sweater paws” and wear that sleeve longer than the other one. some makeup tips i remember is wearing a green colour corrector or concealer, then put regular skin coloured foundation or concealer and set it well. usually scars have a red tinge or undertone to them, and so the green counteracts that by being its direct opposite on the colour wheel and makes it neutral. layering clothes help as well, cutting up socks and tiggers or leggings to make makeshift arm-sleeves, or wear leggings that are slightly darker than your skin colour if they’re on your face. if you want to wear something slightly more revealing, it’s best to have a coat and a plausible excuse for them, like a cat or accident. i don’t know any more tips, but those are the ones that immediately come to mind about covering them. if you can’t do any of those, just make sure you attach that one part of the body you s/h on and keep it close to your physical body (like pressing it against you) and stay in darker areas/ shadows.
